error_scenarios.resolution: llm_models(operation='list_models') and retry with a valid id

Set HF_TOKEN; see huggingface tool docs

best_practices.rationale: One health_check at session start prevents cascading failures
24 GB is shared; unload what is not in use
Small/fast for interactive, large for complex, vLLM for batch
Relay error, error_type, and recovery_options; never fake success
Unload models you loaded and stop engines you started
